# API routes

!!! note "Generated page"
    `scripts/docs/gen_routes.py` builds this page from the code. Text that needs a person lives in `scripts/docs/descriptions.yml`. Edit that file, not this page.

Paths are relative to the app. `API_ROOT_PATH`, default `/api`, sets the FastAPI root path.

The Auth column uses three values:

- `API key` routes pass through `get_api_key`, which compares the header named by `CONSERVER_HEADER_NAME` with the keys from `CONSERVER_API_TOKEN` and `CONSERVER_API_TOKEN_FILE`. With no keys configured, the check is skipped and the route is open.
- `ingress API key` routes call `validate_ingress_api_key`, which checks the same header against the `ingress_auth` section of the configuration for the named ingress list. With no match the API returns 403, including when `ingress_auth` is empty.
- `none` routes have no check.
